already-true.description: A quality you no longer have to force — it's just how you are now.
already-true.example: e.g. I rest before I'm depleted, not after.

practicing-now.description: Something you're growing into, not yet automatic.
practicing-now.example: e.g. Saying "let me think about it" instead of an instant yes.

values-principles.description: A value you want to steer by.
values-principles.example: e.g. Depth over breadth — a few things, done with care.

desired-feelings.description: A feeling you want more room for in ordinary days.

beliefs-practice.description: A belief, and how it shows up in what you do.
beliefs-practice.example: e.g. My work is enough — so I stop at a good stopping point.

embodiment-cues.description: A small physical reminder of who you're being.
embodiment-cues.example: e.g. Shoulders down, slow exhale, before I open the laptop.

identity-shifts.description: A change you've noticed in yourself, however small.
identity-shifts.example: e.g. I used to over-explain; lately I let a "no" stand.

title.description: Optional. A handful of words to find this by later.
